Immunome, Inc. (NASDAQ: IMNM) today announced that its earlier program received a PDUFA target action date of March 15, 2023, following U.S. FDA acceptance of the New Drug Application (NDA).

The U.S. FDA accepted the NDA with a PDUFA target action date of March 15, 2023 under the standard review timeline.

Following its review, the U.S. FDA assigned a PDUFA target action date of March 15, 2023 for the therapy.
